verdict.rationale: Claude Design's built-in AI generates visuals from descriptions inside the product, and hands-on users report generating images and animated SVGs, which covers only part of the image-generation chore. None of the specific asset utilities are documented, and the Canva asset generation is a third-party integration, not credited here. missing for 10: dedicated raster image generation, background removal, content-aware fill, in-editor copy suggestions, independent corroboration of asset-quality output

support.subject: As a designer, built-in AI handles asset chores — image generation, background removal, content-aware fills, copy suggestions — inside the editor

citations.quote: Describe a visual and Claude builds a first version, on brand.
I've been using Claude Design to make animated SVGs.
